text: MEDVET — MODELO Y ESQUEMA DE BASE DE DATOS (11 ENTIDADES)
Arquitectura Relacional PostgreSQL / Knex / FeathersJS — EHR & Guardia 24/7

USERS (Usuarios)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
📧 email : VARCHAR (UQ)
🔒 password : VARCHAR (Hash)
👤 name : VARCHAR
📞 phone : VARCHAR
🎭 role : ENUM ('admin', 'vet'...)
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP
⏱️ updated_at : TIMESTAMP

PROFESSIONALS (Especialistas)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id : UUID (FK->users.id, UQ)
🩺 specialty : VARCHAR
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

SCHEDULES (Horarios / Turnos)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
📅 day_of_week : INT (0-6)
⏰ start_time : TIME
⏰ end_time : TIME
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)

SHIFT_HANDOVERS (Pase Guardia 24/7)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 outgoing_doctor_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
🔗 incoming_doctor_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
🚨 shift_type : ENUM ('guardia_24h'...)
📅 shift_date : DATE
🏥 admitted_patients_count : INT
🔪 surgeries_count : INT
🚨 emergencies_count : INT
✅ discharges_count : INT
⚠️ critical_patients_notes : TEXT
📌 pending_tasks : TEXT

PETS (Mascotas / Pacientes)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id : UUID (FK->users.id)
🐾 name : VARCHAR
🐕 species : VARCHAR
🧬 breed : VARCHAR
🎂 age : INT
⚖️ weight : DECIMAL(5,2)
🖼️ photo : VARCHAR
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

APPOINTMENTS (Citas Médicas)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id : UUID (FK->users.id)
🔗 pet_id : UUID (FK->pets.id)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
🔗 service_id : UUID (FK->services.id)
📅 date : DATE
⏰ start_time : TIME
⏰ end_time : TIME
📊 status : ENUM ('pending', 'confirmed'...)
📋 notes : TEXT
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

SERVICES (Catálogo Clínico)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
📋 name : VARCHAR
📝 description : TEXT
⏳ duration : INT (Minutos)
💵 price : DECIMAL(10,2) (USD)
🏷️ category : ENUM ('consulta'...)
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

VACCINATIONS (Carnet QR)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 pet_id : UUID (FK->pets.id)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
💉 vaccine_name : VARCHAR
🏷️ type : ENUM ('vacuna', 'desparasitacion'...)
📦 batch_number : VARCHAR
🏢 manufacturer : VARCHAR
📅 applied_date : DATE
📅 next_due_date : DATE
📊 status : ENUM ('aplicada', 'pendiente')

MEDICAL_RECORDS (Historia Clínica EHR)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 pet_id : UUID (FK->pets.id)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
🔗 appointment_id : UUID (FK->appt.)
🏷️ record_type : ENUM ('consulta', 'urgencia'...)
📝 reason_for_visit : TEXT
⚖️ weight_kg / temp / hr / rr : DECIMAL/INT
👄 mucous_membranes / crt : VARCHAR
📖 anamnesis / findings : TEXT
🔬 presumptive / definitive diag : TEXT
💊 treatment_plan / prescription : TEXT
📊 patient_status : ENUM ('estable', 'critico'...)

CLINICAL_ATTACHMENTS (Visor RX & Lab)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 pet_id : UUID (FK->pets.id)
🔗 medical_record_id : UUID (FK->med_rec)
🔗 uploaded_by : UUID (FK->users.id)
🩻 title : VARCHAR
📁 category : ENUM ('radiografia', 'ecografia'...)
🌐 file_url : VARCHAR
🖼️ thumbnail_url : VARCHAR
📝 findings : TEXT
📅 study_date : DATE

SURGERIES (Quirófano & Protocolos)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 pet_id : UUID (FK->pets.id)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
🔗 medical_record_id : UUID (FK->med_rec)
🔪 surgery_name : VARCHAR
🏷️ surgery_type : ENUM ('programada'...)
🩺 pre_op_evaluation (ASA) : TEXT
💉 anesthesia_protocol : TEXT
🔪 surgical_technique : TEXT
🛌 post_op_orders : TEXT
📊 status : ENUM ('programada', 'completada')
